data.name: SqlSelectCommand1.CommandText
data.value: SELECT IntermediaryGuid, IntermediaryName, Address1, Address2, City, County, State, ZipCode, ZipPlus, ISNULL(REPLACE(Phone, '-', ''), '') AS Phone, ISNULL(REPLACE(Fax, '-', ''), '') AS Fax, WebSite, Region, ISOCountryCode, IntermediaryID, Email, BillingSameAsPrimary, BillingAddress1, BillingAddress2, BillingCity, BillingCounty, BillingState, BillingZipCode, BillingZipPlus, BillingRegion, BillingISOCountryCode, NAIC, ISNULL(CountryCodeforPhone, 'USA') AS CountryCodeforPhone, ISNULL(CountryCodeforFax, 'USA') AS CountryCodeforFax FROM tblIntermediaries ORDER BY IntermediaryName

data.name: SqlUpdateCommand1.CommandText
data.value: UPDATE tblIntermediaries SET IntermediaryGuid = @IntermediaryGuid, IntermediaryName = @IntermediaryName, Address1 = @Address1, Address2 = @Address2, City = @City, County = @County, State = @State, ZipCode = @ZipCode, ZipPlus = @ZipPlus, Phone = @Phone, Fax = @Fax, WebSite = @WebSite, Region = @Region, ISOCountryCode = @ISOCountryCode, Email = @Email, BillingSameAsPrimary = @BillingSameAsPrimary, BillingAddress1 = @BillingAddress1, BillingAddress2 = @BillingAddress2, BillingCity = @BillingCity, BillingCounty = @BillingCounty, BillingState = @BillingState, BillingZipCode = @BillingZipCode, BillingZipPlus = @BillingZipPlus, BillingRegion = @BillingRegion, BillingISOCountryCode = @BillingISOCountryCode, NAIC = @NAIC, CountryCodeforPhone = @CountryCodeforPhone, CountryCodeforFax = @CountryCodeforFax WHERE (IntermediaryGuid = @Original_IntermediaryGuid); SELECT IntermediaryGuid, IntermediaryName, Address1, Address2, City, County, State, ZipCode, ZipPlus, Phone, Fax, WebSite, Region, ISOCountryCode, IntermediaryID, Email, BillingSameAsPrimary, BillingAddress1, BillingAddress2, BillingCity, BillingCounty, BillingState, BillingZipCode, BillingZipPlus, BillingRegion, BillingISOCountryCode, NAIC, CountryCodeforPhone, CountryCodeforFax FROM tblIntermediaries WHERE (IntermediaryGuid = @IntermediaryGuid) ORDER BY IntermediaryName
